area: PHYSOBJS, RAYCASTING, OBSTRUCTION, OCCLUDER FADING (holtburger-web scene3d + wasm SessionHandle collision layer)
summary:
FRAME. Every world child group hangs under worldRoot (scene3d/index.js:1552-1561, rotation.x=-PI/2; children terrain/buildings/statics/cells/entities). Group-local coords are AC world metres: x east, y north, z up, global = lbX*192 + lbLocalX (lbX=(lbId>>>24)&0xff, lbY=(lbId>>>16)&0xff). three world = acToThree(ax,ay,az)=[ax,az,-ay] (adapter.js:1817); acQuatToThree(qw,qx,qy,qz)->Quaternion(qx,qy,qz,qw) (adapter.js:1395). Distances are equal in both frames. Layers: terrain/buildings/statics on layer 0; cellsGroup+entitiesGroup on layer 1 (index.js:1592-1593). The camera enables both (index.js:1650), but atmosphere_pipeline.js CameraLayerMaskPass (:111-124) rewrites camera.layers.mask mid-frame indoors, so a raycaster must set its own mask (picking.js:558 does layers.enable(1)). Heading: LocalPlayerPose.heading and EntityManager.getHeading are CCW yaw (0=north, +PI/2=west); compass = -yaw.

1) ENTITY REGISTRY. window.liveScene3d.entityManager.entityMap is a Map<u32 guid, EntityInstance> (entities.js:4178; set at spawn commit :5568, deleted in remove() :13497). EntityInstance fields (:3733):
- guid
- root: THREE.Group named entity_<guid8hex> (:4737), child of entitiesGroup. root.position is AC world metres. root.quaternion is the AC yaw. root.scale is obj_scale.
- parts[]: per-part Groups.
- meta: plain copy built by loop.js toMeta (:3480). Fields: guid, modelId==setupId (0x02 Setup DID), landblockId (full cell id), x/y/z (LB-local at spawn), qw..qz, wcid, itemType, name, iconId, objScale, physicsTranslucency, paletteId, mtableId, placementId, motionCommand/Stance, vx/vy/vz, physicsScriptDid, soundTableDid, objDescFlags.
- Private fields: _baseScale (:5436), _spawnCellId (:5412), _wireCellId, _attachedParentGuid/_attachedChildren (wielded items are their own entities, parented under the wielder's part node), _stateVisible/_renderCullHidden, _nameplateSprite, _buffBadgeSprite, _speechBubble, _selectionRing, _camFadeOpacity, _objectTranslucency, _ethereal, _wirePos.
- GOTCHA: root.userData.modelId holds the WCID, not the setup (:4747).

EntityManager accessors:
- getHeading(guid): raw CCW yaw or null (:15988).
- getLocalPlayerHeading(): followYaw convention, CW from north (:15938).
- getLocalPlayerWorldPos(): returns the predicted pose first (:15818).
- findGuidByName(name): returns the oldest live guid with that name (:7824).
- getSelectedTarget() / setSelectedTarget(guid) (:8748) / deselectTarget() (:9654).
- isProjectile(guid).

Window globals:
- window.liveScene3d (scene3d/index.js:4420). Exposes the groups, worldRoot, camera (the perspective camera, the same object as cameraSwitcher.persp), cameraSwitcher, cellContainers3d (Map cellId->Group), staticsBakedLbs, buildingsBakedLbs, selectionBracketLayer, nameplateLayer.
- window.__sessionHandle (index.html:4553).
- window.getLocalPlayerGuid() (index.html:3516).
- window.__lastEntityWorldPos: Map guid->{x,y,z,ts} in AC world (loop.js:3959).
- window.__wom: WorldObjectManager (index.html:4704). get(guid).className, byClass('Creature') with taxonomy descendants, snapshot().

Wasm world view (does not depend on spawn gating):
- sh.nearbyEntityGuids(maxRangeM): range measured from the LOCAL PLAYER (d.ts:5232).
- objectPosition(guid) -> Float64Array[lbId,x,y,z] LB-local (:5400).
- objectPartDims(guid) -> Float32Array[radius,height]: CPartArray GetRadius/GetHeight * scale; empty until the Setup is resident (:5386).
- objectPhysicsState, objectName, objectWcid, objectIntProperty.

KIND classification:
- meta.itemType bits (nameplate_sprite.js:371-397 categoryForItemType): CREATURE 0x10, PORTAL 0x10000, LIFE_STONE 0x10000000, CONTAINER 0x200.
- meta.objDescFlags (target_cycle.js:47-49, :135-142, :711-713): PLAYER 0x8, ATTACKABLE 0x10, PK 0x20, UI_HIDDEN 0x80, VENDOR 0x200, DOOR 0x1000, CORPSE 0x2000, LIFESTONE 0x4000, PORTAL 0x40000, BINDSTONE 0x8000000.
- matchesSelectionType (:103).
- GUID tiers: 0x5 players, 0x8 dynamic, 0x7 world-static.

BOUNDS. object_radius.js is NOT a bounding-radius module. It implements ?objRadius=N (default 4): statics and buildings are baked only within Chebyshev N landblocks of the player and hidden beyond N+1. Real bounds sources:
- (a) objectPartDims: cylinder r/h.
- (b) sh.creatureSeparationTable() {setupIds, radii (first cylsphere, else first sphere; unscaled), playerRadius 0.48, epsilon 2e-4} (d.ts:835/3723). Memoised by EntityManager._refreshSeparationTable/_separationFloor (:8980/:9021).
- (c) wasm fetchSetupSelectionSphere(setupId) -> {cx,cy,cz,radius,valid} in object-local space (d.ts:8736/6984). Cached via selection_brackets.js loadDatSelectionSphere (:624) / peekDatSelectionSphere (:614). datSelectionSphereFor(rec,root) (:666) gives the offset plus radius*scale.z. World centre = offset.applyMatrix4(root.matrixWorld) (:954-957).
- (d) computeSelectionSphere(root): Box3 heuristic (:690).
- (e) Fixed ENTITY_CULL_RADIUS = 6 m (entities.js:3018).
- (f) Occlusion AABB _occEntityBox (module-private, :3250): rig Box3 + 0.6 m pad.

2) STATICS / BUILDINGS. staticsGroup holds a mix of node types:
- Singleton Mesh static-<placementKey> (statics.js:1906-1926). userData {modelId, surfaceDid, landblockId, placementKey, isBuilding:false, source:'landblockinfo'|'scenery'}. position is AC world.
- InstancedMesh per (model, surface) (:2107-2135). userData {modelId, surfaceDid, instanceCount, source, sceneryCount, landblockInfoCount, coversLbKeys}; per-instance world matrices.
- LOD wrappers.
- Per-LB staticBatch BatchedMesh.
- statBatchChunk region BatchedMeshes (DEFAULT ON).
- Cross-LB statAtlas BatchedMeshes stat-atlas-x-<bucket> (DEFAULT ON; static_atlas.js:1342-1380; userData.__statAtlasCrossLb; no landblockId; frustumCulled=false, perObjectFrustumCulled=true).
- Static particle meshes (userData.__particle / isParticleInstanced) and default-script anchors.
- Animated scenery (?animScenery default ON).

Buildings: buildings.js:545-625 builds Group building-<placementKey> -> part-N hinge Group -> surface-<did> Mesh, with userData {modelId, landblockId, placementKey, isBuilding:true, partGroups}. BUT ?buildingBatch is DEFAULT ON (buildings.js:127, code reads !== 'off' even though a header comment says default-off), so _feedBuildingGroupsToAtlas (:150) flattens building surfaces into the cross-LB atlas inside staticsGroup. buildingsGroup keeps only the residue. As a result, most statics and buildings lose per-placement identity: atlas membership is a module-private _lbMembership row {bucketKey, gid, iid, texUuid}.

There is NO retained JS placement index. lb_objects_shared.js is a transient cache that drops an entry after 2 reads; it cannot be queried. Ways to enumerate:
- wasm fetch_landblock_objects_soa(Uint32Array.of(lbKey|0xFFFE)) -> LandblockObjectsSoa{len, modelIds, positions (LB-local), quaternions (qw,qx,qy,qz), scales, isBuilding, landblockIds} (d.ts:2153/9070).
- fetch_landblock_scenery_soa -> {objIds (Setup DID), positions, quaternions, scales, defaultScriptId, ...}; it carries no AABBs (d.ts:2184/9114).
- Raw dist/scenery/0xXXYY.scenery.jsonl: rows carry aabb_min/max_x/y/z (LB-local, full model extent including the canopy), obj_id and stable_id.
- EnvCell statics via fetchEnvCellsInLandblock(lb)[i].takeStaticObjects() -> StaticObjectPlacement{did, x,y,z in WORLD coords, q, aabbLocal[6]} (d.ts:7406/8520).
- Spawns via fetch_landblock_spawns_soa.
- Introspect the batches: BatchedMesh getMatrixAt(iid) / getBoundingSphereAt(gid); InstancedMesh getMatrixAt(i).

Tree / rock / building distinction:
- isBuilding.
- source='scenery' (procedural trees/rocks/bushes) vs 'landblockinfo' (props).
- vfx_catalog.js vfxDescriptorFor(did) (:159). Covers 1168 Setup DIDs from dist/vfx/visual_descriptors.jsonl. Archetypes: tip-flex 404, rigid-glint 340, foliage-pollen 269, trunk-canopy 103, gem-sparkle 41, creature-breath 9, brazier 1. Signals: category (Prop 550 / Scenery 437 / Unknown 159 / Interactive_Portal / Creature / Furniture), maxDimension, aspectRatio, partCount.
- tree_wind.js isTreeDid is only a 6-DID allowlist.
- The wasm scenery colliders know Cylinder (trunk) vs Sphere (boulder), but this is not exported to JS.

3) RAYCASTING. picking.js pickEntityAt(clientX, clientY) (:948; exposed as window.__pickEntityAt :1964):
- three r184 Raycaster on layers 0+1.
- Tests only VISIBLE entity roots, recursive into rig parts, near-to-far; skips the local player and hidden parts.
- Fallback: pickBySphere -> pick_math.js pickNearestSphereHit (:46) over part bounding spheres. sphereRayEntry (:20) returns -1 when the ray starts inside the sphere.
- Statics, buildings, terrain and cells are never tested (F7 TODO at :963), and there is no BVH anywhere. So __pickEntityAt returns an NPC that is behind a wall: it is not an LOS test.

three r184 BatchedMesh.raycast (node_modules/three/src/objects/BatchedMesh.js:1382) walks EVERY active+visible instance linearly (bbox/sphere, then triangles) and sets intersect.batchId = instance id; InstancedMesh gives instanceId. A visual raycast into staticsGroup can therefore name the blocking instance, but costs O(all ring instances) per ray.

ragdoll_env.js _collectTargets (:461) / _castAC (:503) is the in-repo pattern for an AC-frame visual raycast against a bounded list of at most 64 meshes from cellsGroup+buildingsGroup, culled by bounding sphere.

WASM SWEEPS on SessionHandle. Shared contract:
- All endpoints are GLOBAL AC world metres.
- Each returns a wasm-bindgen CollisionHit {t in [0,1], x,y,z hit point, normalX/Y/Z pointing back toward the origin} or undefined.
- t~0 means the sweep started embedded. The caller must call hit.free().
- The hit carries NO object identity.

Per-layer sweeps (d.ts / src/lib.rs):
- cameraSweepCollision(fx,fy,fz,tx,ty,tz,r,lbId): coarse building per-part AABBs (d.ts:3496 / lib.rs:43793).
- sweepSphereAgainstBuildingMesh(...,r,lbId): physics triangles of ONE landblock, linear scan (d.ts:6505 / lib.rs:43845 / scene.rs:5854).
- sweepSphereAgainstStatics(...,r,lbId): LandBlockInfo stab AABBs, whole-AABB slab test, over the 3x3 ring around lbId (d.ts:6611).
- sweepSphereAgainstScenery(...,r,lbId): trunk cylspheres and boulder spheres over the 3x3 ring; canopies are not colliders (d.ts:6598 / scene.rs:4974).
- sweepSphereAgainstCellMesh(...,r,Uint32Array cellIds): EnvCell shells (d.ts:6522).
- sweepSphereAgainstCellStatics(...,r,cellIds): furniture BSPs (d.ts:6540).
- sweepSphereAgainstEntities(...,r,maxRangeM): collidable HAS_PHYSICS_BSP objects, i.e. closed doors and chests. Skips the local player; creatures are excluded; open doors are ETHEREAL and skipped (d.ts:6565 / lib.rs:44053).
- sweepSphereAgainstObjects(...,r,missileGuid,exemptLocalPlayer): creatures, players and props by Setup cylspheres/spheres at the wasm body pose. Skips guid==missileGuid, parented objects, contained objects and MISSILE/ETHEREAL objects. missileGuid's own PhysicsState sets the filter: if it is ETHEREAL, only STATIC objects count. Passing the SUBJECT's guid therefore excludes the subject (missile_sweep.rs:144-190).
- clipCameraToCellSpace(...,r,startCell) -> t or undefined (d.ts:3621).
- terrainHeightAt(wx,wy) -> physics z, or undefined if the landblock is not resident (d.ts:6652 / lib.rs:43725). Drawn ground = that + visual_ground.js visualGroundDeltaAt (:466), |dz| <= 8 cm.
- resolveViewerCell / setViewerCell / getViewerCell / getViewerRenderSet / getRenderSet(depth). getRenderSet is the player-rooted BFS.

RESIDENCY. Building, static and scenery collision is populated ONLY for the 3x3 landblock ring around the player: app/landblock_stream.js ensureBuildingAabbsAroundLandblock (:584) calls populateBuildingAabbsForLandblock, populateStaticsAabbsForLandblock and populateSceneryCollidersForLandblock. These are staged and land on the next TickMovement; the collision mirror refreshes at most every 100 ms. EnvCell physics triangles are staged per dungeon landblock on EnvCell load. Check with __diag.collision.residency().

Reference chain: camera.js _clipCameraAgainstWorld (:1769):
- Order: terrain floor (+0.7), building AABB (off), building mesh, statics, scenery, cell mesh, cell statics, entities (range = segment length + 2 m), then indoor cell clamp.
- Retail viewer sphere is 0.3 m from pivot z+1.5, with a 0.02 m skin (viewer_cell.js:44/51).
- Clipping formula: final = start + delta*(t - backoff/len).

projectile_sweep.js sweepProjectileSegment(sh,p0,p1,opts) (:186) already chains the layers and reports the winning layer in opts.out.layer. projectileTerrainCrossing(p0,p1,terrainZAt,eps) (:273) is a pure terrain line-of-sight march with bisection.

4) OCCLUDER FADING. There is NO system that fades or dithers occluders between the camera and the player.
- canopy_soften.js only bends tree-canopy normals for lighting.
- fade_alpha_state.js is a state helper for ENTITY fade owners. Call snapshotAuthoredAlpha(mat) (:71) before writing opacity and syncFadeAlpha(mat) (:94) after. While faded it sets alphaTest 0, NormalBlending, transparent, depthWrite=false; at full opacity it calls restoreAuthoredAlpha.

Entity fade owners (entities.js):
- setLocalPlayerCameraOpacity(guid,o) (:18991): one remembered slot (_localCamFade); hierarchical over held items (?camFadeHier, default ON). camera.js _applyCameraPlayerFade (:2156) pushes nearFadeOpacity each frame in follow mode under ?retailCamZoom (default ON).
- _applyCamFadeToInst(inst,o) (:19098): works on ANY rig; snapshot keys __preCamFadeOpacity / __preCamFadeDepthWrite.
- applyObjectTranslucency(guid,t) (:18870): owned by the server PhysicsDesc translucency; snapshot key __preObjTransOpacity.
- _applyEtherealToEntity.
- All of them clone per-entity materials via _getOrCloneEntityMaterial and cost a program swap when a fade starts.

Statics and buildings can only be HIDDEN:
- Per BatchedMesh instance via bm.setVisibleAt(iid,false).
- Per landblock via parkStaticAtlasForLb / parkStaticBatchXForLb (static_atlas.js:2029, static_batch_x.js:2975; also exposed as liveScene3d._parkStaticAtlasForLb).
- Singleton .visible is rewritten every frame by statics.js cullStaticsGroup (:4510). BatchedMesh nodes are forced visible unless userData.__deadBatch is set.

5) HIDING HUD AND AVATARS.
- ?hud=none: CSS html.no-hud hides all non-#stage DOM (index.html:536-539, 614). It also skips the DOM nameplate layer and the bracket overlay (index.js:3195-3263) and disables sprite nameplates and buff badges (nameplate_sprite.js:311).
- Sprite nameplates are OFF by default (?nameplates=on); DOM nameplates are OFF by default (?nameplateDom=on).
- Selection brackets are ON by default: a DOM div #selection-brackets-3d, which agent-mode CSS FORCE-SHOWS (index.html:525). Disable with ?selectionIndicator=none, or selectionBracketLayer.setDisplayOn(false) (:898; sticks until CharacterOption 0x0E changes), or setSelectedTarget(0).
- The torus selection ring appears only in ring/both mode. ?selectionFlash is OFF; ?spellShapePreview is OFF; ?castRangeRing is OFF; the cast-stability ring is opt-in via localStorage.
- SPEECH BUBBLES are ALWAYS ON with no flag: a Sprite named speech_bubble on root at z+3.05, depthTest false (draws through walls), 4.5 s hold + 1.2 s fade (speech_bubble.js:171/237; EntityManager.showSpeechBubble :7154).
- Entity visibility is the composite stateVisible && !renderCullHidden, written only by _applyEntityVisible (:2972). tickEntityRenderVisibility (:3093) writes only when the cull state CHANGES and never culls the local player.
- Do NOT use setVisibility(guid,false) to hide: via play_effect_vfx noteEntityVisibility it PLAYS the PS_Hidden script.
- An opacity fade to 0 still CASTS SHADOWS, because shadow_caster_list.js walks only `visible`.

6) PHYSICS DATA EXPOSED TO JS.
- __diag.collision (diag/collision.js): selfTest(), residency() (19 counters), audit(), populate(lbId) (async; forces the populate for ANY landblock).
- __diag.physics: local-player drift only.
- __diag.entityTypes: slices __wom.
- No BSP, cylsphere or triangle data reaches JS. Available instead: the sweeps, StaticObjectPlacement.aabbLocal, the scenery JSONL AABBs, creatureSeparationTable, objectPartDims and SetupSelectionSphere.

FRAME ORDER (loop.js _tickPerFrameBody): tickCellVisibility3D (:2857; also resolves the viewer cell and runs occlusion beginFrame) -> tickFrustumCull (:2879) -> cameraSwitcher.tick (:3235) -> entityManager.tick (:3264) -> render.
- The culls use the PREVIOUS frame's camera matrices.
- The GPU occlusion culler (DEFAULT ON) reveals 1-2 frames late, with hide hysteresis of 3 to 24 frames. window.__occlusionCull.off disarms it; .hiddenKeys() returns 'e<guid>' keys and cell ids.
- Entities more than 120 m from the ACTIVE camera stop ticking (MAX_TICK_DIST :2887; ?maxTickDist).
- Every camera consumer resolves cameraSwitcher.activeCamera ?? liveScene3d.camera.

apis.name: EntityManager.entityMap
apis.signature: Map<number /*u32 guid*/, EntityInstance>
apis.what: The live rig registry. inst.root.position is AC world metres; inst.meta holds the spawn meta (setupId, name, itemType, objDescFlags, wcid, objScale...). Reach it via window.liveScene3d.entityManager.entityMap.

apis.name: EntityInstance
apis.signature: class EntityInstance { guid; root: THREE.Group; parts: THREE.Group[]; meta; setPose(x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz) }
apis.what: Per-entity rig. root is named entity_<guid8hex> (:4737). root.userData = {modelId: WCID (not setup!), landblockId, name} (:4747). _baseScale holds obj_scale.

apis.name: loop.js toMeta (spawn meta schema)
apis.signature: toMeta(upd) -> {guid, modelId, setupId, landblockId, x,y,z (LB-local), qw,qx,qy,qz, wcid, itemType, name, iconId, objScale, physicsTranslucency, paletteId, mtableId, placementId, motionCommand, motionStance, vx,vy,vz, modelChanges, textureChanges, subPalettes, physicsScriptDid, soundTableDid, objDescFlags}
apis.what: The exact field set on inst.meta, used for subject kind classification and setup lookups.

apis.name: EntityManager.getHeading
apis.signature: getHeading(guid: number): number | null
apis.what: Raw CCW yaw about +Z (0 = north) from root.quaternion. getLocalPlayerHeading() (:15938) returns the negated CW-from-north value.

apis.name: EntityManager.getLocalPlayerWorldPos
apis.signature: getLocalPlayerWorldPos(): {x,y,z} | null
apis.what: Local player AC world pose. Prefers cameraSwitcher.getPredictedPlayerWorldPos(), then the rig, then the 2D map, then __lastEntityWorldPos.

apis.name: EntityManager.findGuidByName
apis.signature: findGuidByName(name: string): number /*0 if none*/
apis.what: O(1) name->guid lookup. Returns the oldest live entity with that name; useful for resolving script subjects.

apis.name: EntityManager.setVisibility
apis.signature: setVisibility(guid: number, visible: boolean): void
apis.what: Server-state visibility (NoDraw/Hidden/Cloaked). It also calls play_effect_vfx noteEntityVisibility, which plays PS_Hidden/UnHide scripts. NOT safe for film hiding.

apis.name: _applyEntityVisible / _setEntityStateVisible
apis.signature: function _applyEntityVisible(inst) /* root.visible = _stateVisible!==false && !_renderCullHidden */
apis.what: The single writer of rig visibility (module-private). This is the place to add a film-hide term.

apis.name: tickEntityRenderVisibility
apis.signature: export function tickEntityRenderVisibility(scene3d, culler) -> {tested, culled, occluded, cellGated}
apis.what: Per-frame entity cull. Combines a frustum test (6 m sphere), an optional cullDist, ?rigCellGate and the GPU occlusion culler. Exempts the local player, attached children and light owners.

apis.name: EntityManager.setLocalPlayerCameraOpacity
apis.signature: setLocalPlayerCameraOpacity(guid: number, opacity: number /*0..1*/): void
apis.what: Hierarchical camera fade (body plus held items). Stores ONE remembered slot, _localCamFade, which re-applies after re-dress/respawn.

apis.name: EntityManager._applyCamFadeToInst
apis.signature: _applyCamFadeToInst(inst: EntityInstance, o: number): void
apis.what: Per-rig opacity fade on any entity. Uses snapshot keys __preCamFadeOpacity/__preCamFadeDepthWrite and syncFadeAlpha. Template for a film fade owner.

apis.name: EntityManager.applyObjectTranslucency
apis.signature: applyObjectTranslucency(guid: number, translucency: number /*0 opaque..1 clear*/): void
apis.what: Whole-object translucency owner, driven by the server PhysicsDesc. Multiplicative with snapshot __preObjTransOpacity; server updates overwrite it.

apis.name: EntityManager.setSelectedTarget / deselectTarget
apis.signature: setSelectedTarget(guid: number /*0 clears*/): void; deselectTarget(): void /*:9654*/
apis.what: Drives the bracket overlay (selectionBracketLayer.setTarget) and the legacy torus. Set 0 for HUD-free capture.

apis.name: EntityManager.showSpeechBubble
apis.signature: showSpeechBubble(guid: number, text: string, isEmote: boolean): void
apis.what: Always-on overhead speech sprite (speech_bubble.js showSpeechBubbleOnEntity :171, removeSpeechBubbleFromEntity :237). Override or gate it during takes.

apis.name: SessionHandle.sweepSphereAgainstBuildingMesh
apis.signature: sweepSphereAgainstBuildingMesh(from_x,from_y,from_z,to_x,to_y,to_z,radius,landblock_id): CollisionHit | undefined
apis.what: Sweeps against building GfxObj physics triangles of ONE landblock (linear scan; scene.rs:5854). Long segments must be swept per landblock crossed.

apis.name: SessionHandle.sweepSphereAgainstStatics
apis.signature: sweepSphereAgainstStatics(from_x,from_y,from_z,to_x,to_y,to_z,radius,landblock_id): CollisionHit | undefined
apis.what: LandBlockInfo stab AABB slab test over the 3x3 ring around landblock_id. Pass the landblock containing `from`, not the player's.

apis.name: SessionHandle.sweepSphereAgainstScenery
apis.signature: sweepSphereAgainstScenery(from_x,from_y,from_z,to_x,to_y,to_z,radius,landblock_id): CollisionHit | undefined
apis.what: Procedural scenery trunk cylspheres and boulder spheres over the 3x3 ring (scene.rs:4974). Canopies are not colliders.

apis.name: SessionHandle.sweepSphereAgainstCellMesh / sweepSphereAgainstCellStatics
apis.signature: sweepSphereAgainstCellMesh(from..., to..., radius, cell_ids: Uint32Array): CollisionHit | undefined; sweepSphereAgainstCellStatics(same) /*:6540*/
apis.what: Covers EnvCell shell triangles and stab-list furniture BSPs for an explicit cell list. The caller chooses the cells (camera uses getRenderSet(1); film can pass resident dungeon cells).

apis.name: SessionHandle.sweepSphereAgainstEntities
apis.signature: sweepSphereAgainstEntities(from..., to..., radius, max_range_m): CollisionHit | undefined
apis.what: Collidable HAS_PHYSICS_BSP entities: closed doors and chests. Skips the local player and creatures; open doors are ETHEREAL and skipped (lib.rs:44053).

apis.name: SessionHandle.sweepSphereAgainstObjects
apis.signature: sweepSphereAgainstObjects(from..., to..., radius, missile_guid, exempt_local_player): CollisionHit | undefined
apis.what: Creatures, players and props by Setup cylspheres/spheres. Skips missile_guid (so passing the subject guid excludes the subject), parented, contained, MISSILE and ETHEREAL objects (missile_sweep.rs:144).

apis.name: SessionHandle.cameraSweepCollision
apis.signature: cameraSweepCollision(from..., to..., radius, landblock_id): CollisionHit | undefined
apis.what: Coarse building per-part AABB sweep. Over-bounds rotated buildings by up to 4.9 m, so the camera leaves it off by default.

apis.name: CollisionHit
apis.signature: class CollisionHit { t; x; y; z; normalX; normalY; normalZ; free() }
apis.what: t in [0,1] (0 = embedded start), world hit point, normal pointing back toward the origin. Carries NO object id. The caller must free() it.

apis.name: SessionHandle.clipCameraToCellSpace
apis.signature: clipCameraToCellSpace(from..., to..., radius, start_cell): number | undefined
apis.what: Indoor containment walk with portal re-seat. Returns the clamp t when the segment would leave cell space.

apis.name: SessionHandle.terrainHeightAt
apis.signature: terrainHeightAt(world_x, world_y): number | undefined
apis.what: Physics terrain z on the retail split diagonal (lib.rs:43725). Returns undefined if the landblock is not resident.

apis.name: SessionHandle.resolveViewerCell / setViewerCell / getViewerRenderSet / getRenderSet
apis.signature: resolveViewerCell(from...,to...,radius,player_cell): number; setViewerCell(cell) /*:6395*/; getViewerRenderSet(): Uint32Array /*:4825*/; getRenderSet(depth): Uint32Array /*:4541, player-rooted*/
apis.what: Viewer-cell and render-set walks used by indoor rendering and the camera clip. They are rooted at the player unless setViewerCell is set.

apis.name: SessionHandle.objectPartDims / objectPosition / nearbyEntityGuids / objectPhysicsState
apis.signature: objectPartDims(guid): Float32Array /*[radius,height] or empty*/; objectPosition(guid): Float64Array /*[lbId,x,y,z] LB-local*/; nearbyEntityGuids(max_range_m): Uint32Array /*from local player*/; objectPhysicsState(guid): number
apis.what: Wasm world-state queries, independent of render spawns. Use them for subject cylinders and scene enumeration.

apis.name: SessionHandle.creatureSeparationTable
apis.signature: creatureSeparationTable(): CreatureSeparationTable {setupIds: Uint32Array, radii: Float32Array, playerRadius: number, epsilon: number}
apis.what: Per-Setup collision radii: the first cylsphere, else the first sphere, unscaled. Multiply by obj_scale.

apis.name: fetchSetupSelectionSphere (+ selection_brackets helpers)
apis.signature: fetchSetupSelectionSphere(setup_id): Promise<SetupSelectionSphere{cx,cy,cz,radius,setupId,valid}>; loadDatSelectionSphere(fetchFn,setupId) /*selection_brackets.js:624*/; peekDatSelectionSphere(setupId) /*:614*/; datSelectionSphereFor(rec, root) -> {offset, radius, local:true} /*:666*/; computeSelectionSphere(root) /*:690*/

hazards.what: root.userData.modelId is the WCID, not the Setup DID. The setup lives in inst.meta.setupId / meta.modelId.
hazards.mitigation: Always read inst.meta.setupId for Setup lookups (selection sphere, separation radii, vfx catalog).

hazards.what: EntityManager.setVisibility(guid,false) routes to play_effect_vfx.noteEntityVisibility. That PLAYS the PS_Hidden script (portal bubbles) on an object whose server state is not NoDraw/Cloaked, and plays UnHide on show.
hazards.mitigation: Add a dedicated film visibility term in _applyEntityVisible; never reuse setVisibility for cosmetic hides.

hazards.what: Opacity fades (camera fade, object translucency, film fade) still cast full shadows: shadow_caster_list.js and three's shadow pass test only `visible`, not opacity.
hazards.mitigation: At o<~0.05 switch to visible=false, or temporarily set castShadow=false on the faded rig's meshes.

hazards.what: Two writers of .visible: cullStaticsGroup rewrites every staticsGroup child's visible each frame and forces BatchedMesh nodes visible, so a film hide via .visible lasts one frame. object_radius.js writes the same flag.
hazards.mitigation: Use an honoured marker in cullStaticsGroup, or per-instance setVisibleAt on BatchedMesh, which this pass never touches.

hazards.what: Statics and buildings mostly lose per-placement identity. buildingBatch is DEFAULT ON (code !== 'off', despite a header comment saying default-OFF) and statAtlas/statBatchChunk are DEFAULT ON, so building Groups are flattened into ring-spanning BatchedMeshes with no landblockId/modelId per instance.
hazards.mitigation: Identify occluders via raycast batchId plus bm.getMatrixAt, or the wasm/JSONL placement data. Use ?buildingBatch=off / ?statAtlas=off only for debugging (big draw-call cost).

hazards.what: Wasm sweep hits carry NO object identity; t~0 means an embedded start (the normal faces the start side); CollisionHit boxes leak unless freed; a stale pkg/ lacks newer exports.
hazards.mitigation: Copy fields then free(). typeof-guard every export (as projectile_sweep.js does). Apply the projectileHitStops rule for embedded hits. Resolve identity in JS afterwards.

hazards.what: Collision data exists only in the 3x3 landblock ring around the PLAYER. statics/scenery sweeps search only the 3x3 ring around the passed lbId; building-mesh sweeps read ONE landblock. A film camera far from the player, or a long LOS segment, silently passes through walls and trees.
hazards.mitigation: Chunk segments to <=192 m, passing landblockOfWorld(chunkStart). Pre-populate collision for landblocks on the camera path and check __diag.collision.residency().

hazards.what: Physics differs from visual geometry. The statics sweep is a whole-AABB slab (over-blocks under canopies). Scenery colliders are trunks and boulders only (canopies never block). Awnings, banners and particle smoke have no colliders.
hazards.mitigation: Use physics sweeps for camera CLEARANCE, and visual raycasts or GPU queries (or the scenery JSONL AABB) for subject VISIBILITY.

hazards.what: getRenderSet(1) is rooted at the player's cell, and cells.js resolves the viewer cell by walking head->eye from the player. An indoor film camera far from the player (behind walls) gets a wrong viewer cell and wrong sweep cell sets.
hazards.mitigation: Seed the viewer cell from the film camera path and pass dungeon cell ids explicitly (e.g. resident ids from liveScene3d.cellContainers3d keys) to sweepSphereAgainstCellMesh/CellStatics.

hazards.what: Cull timing: tickCellVisibility3D and tickFrustumCull run BEFORE cameraSwitcher.tick in _tickPerFrameBody, so culls use last frame's camera matrices. GPU occlusion reveals are 1-2 frames late with 3 to 24 frame hide hysteresis, so NPCs/interiors can pop in when the camera rounds a corner or whips 90 degrees.
hazards.mitigation: Pose the film camera before tickPerFrame and call camera.updateMatrixWorld(). Set window.__occlusionCull.off=true during takes.

hazards.what: Entity animation stops for rigs more than 120 m from the ACTIVE camera (MAX_TICK_DIST). Spawn-time LOD reads window.liveScene3d.camera at spawn, and dynamic LOD respawns rigs at band crossings, so telephoto subjects freeze or swap meshes.
hazards.mitigation: Boot with ?maxTickDist=<max shot distance>. Make the film camera the persp/active camera so the LOD and tick gates measure from it.

hazards.what: ?objRadius default 4: statics and buildings are baked only within 4 landblocks (Chebyshev) of the player and hidden beyond 5. Wide or aerial vistas show bare terrain past ~800 m.
hazards.mitigation: Use ?objRadius=off (full 11x11 ring) for establishing shots, after checking memory headroom on the 8 GB laptop / 1070.

hazards.what: ?skipHiddenMatrix (default ON) leaves matrixWorld of hidden (culled/occluded) nodes stale. A direct .matrixWorld read of a culled subject is wrong.
hazards.mitigation: Read inst.root.position (AC frame), or call getWorldPosition/updateWorldMatrix, which refresh on demand.

hazards.what: camera.layers.mask is rewritten mid-frame by CameraLayerMaskPass indoors. Entity subtrees are re-stamped to layer 1 after every re-dress/ReplaceObject (_stampEntityIndoorLayer), so custom-layer hiding does not stick, and a raycaster that copies camera.layers can miss layer 1.
hazards.mitigation: Give film raycasters an explicit mask (enable 0 and 1). Do not hide via layers.

hazards.what: camera.js under ?retailCamZoom (default ON) pushes setLocalPlayerCameraOpacity(nearFadeOpacity) whenever its quantised value changes in follow mode. setLocalPlayerCameraOpacity keeps ONE remembered slot (_localCamFade), so using it for another guid clobbers the local fade.
hazards.mitigation: While film mode owns the camera, suspend follow positioning or use a separate film fade owner. Never call setLocalPlayerCameraOpacity for non-local entities.

hazards.what: window.__pickEntityAt ignores world geometry (it raycasts entity roots only) and skips the local player, so it reports occluded NPCs as picked.
hazards.mitigation: Do not use it as an LOS oracle; combine it with sweeps or visual raycasts.

hazards.what: three r184 BatchedMesh.raycast is linear over every instance, and atlas buckets span the whole ring (frustumCulled=false). Static particle meshes are direct children of staticsGroup (userData.__particle), and occlusion proxies and blood decals have raycast=noop.
hazards.mitigation: Budget a few rays per frame and pre-filter targets by distance (ragdoll_env pattern). Skip __particle/isParticleInstanced nodes. Spread candidate evaluation over frames.

hazards.what: Rendered rig pose differs from the wasm collision pose. sweepSphereAgainstObjects/Entities use the WorldState body pose (not the dead-reckoned root.position), and installVisualGroundRoot adds visualZ-physicsZ (<=8 cm) to the rig MATRIX only.
hazards.mitigation: Pad subject and occluder radii by ~0.3 m. Treat sweep results near the subject as the subject itself.

hazards.what: Speech bubbles are always on (no flag), depthTest=false, renderOrder 11. Agent-mode CSS force-shows #selection-brackets-3d, so a selected target shows brackets in ?agent=1 captures.
hazards.mitigation: Use ?hud=none or ?selectionIndicator=none, setSelectedTarget(0), and gate showSpeechBubble during takes.

hazards.what: Flag-default footguns: comments and docs say camIndoorObjects is '=on opt-in' but the code is !== 'off' (default ON). The buildingBatch header says default-OFF but the code is default ON. Trust the readers, not the comments.
hazards.mitigation: Verify flag readers in code before assuming film-relevant behaviour.

hazards.what: sweepSphereAgainstEntities/Objects use RefCell try_borrow and silently return 'no hit' when a sweep lands mid-drain. Other sweeps read the collision_scene mirror, which is refreshed at most every 100 ms and only after a TickMovement drain.
hazards.mitigation: For critical decisions, sample over several frames and take the conservative (blocked) answer.

recommendations: Write an import-free scene3d/film_los.js (node-testable, like pick_math.js/projectile_sweep.js). It takes (sh, camP, subjP, subjectGuid, radius). It runs a terrain march (projectileTerrainCrossing with sh.terrainHeightAt), then wasm layers per <=192 m chunk: buildingMesh(lb of chunk), statics(lb), scenery(lb), cellMesh/cellStatics(explicit cell ids), entities(range), objects(missileGuid=subjectGuid). Return {blocked, t, layer, point, normal}. Copy then free() every CollisionHit and typeof-guard exports, as projectile_sweep.js does.

Resolve 'blocked by what' in JS after a physics hit. objects/entities layer: nearest inst.root within (objectPartDims radius + 0.5 m) of the hit point. statics/scenery: a short three Raycaster probe at the hit point against staticsGroup BatchedMesh/InstancedMesh (batchId/instanceId), or containment in scenery JSONL AABBs. buildings: the same probe (buildings live in the atlas by default).

For subject VISIBILITY (not clearance), use a 5-9 ray fan from the camera to points on the subject's DAT selection sphere (center, top, bottom, left, right). Cast against a budgeted ragdoll_env-style target list with raycaster.layers 0+1, skip __particle nodes, and exclude the subject's rig. Report visible-fraction and occluder ids. Optionally cross-check with OcclusionCuller.want('film:<guid>:<k>', subBox) for GPU truth outdoors.

Add a film visibility owner in entities.js. Add inst._filmHidden to _applyEntityVisible plus an exported setFilmHidden(guid, on) and clearAllFilmHidden(). Use it to hide the local avatar and other players (shadows go too) instead of setVisibility or opacity tricks.

Add a film fade owner mirroring _applyCamFadeToInst, with its own snapshot keys and snapshotAuthoredAlpha/syncFadeAlpha. Ramp fades over >=0.3 s and pre-warm (the first fade per material costs a program swap). Below ~5% opacity, switch to film-hidden so the shadow disappears.

For static occluders, add an honoured userData.__filmHidden check in cullStaticsGroup for singletons and InstancedMesh. For BatchedMesh atlas/chunk instances, keep a list of (bm, batchId) from the visual raycast, call setVisibleAt(batchId,false) for the shot, and restore on cut. Never write .visible directly.

HUD-free capture profile: boot with ?hud=none&agent=1&selectionIndicator=none&nosw=1. Then at runtime call entityManager.setSelectedTarget(0) and override entityManager.showSpeechBubble = () => {} (or add a real ?speechBubbles=off flag) for the duration of a take. Nameplates, spell previews, range rings and selection flash are already default-off.

Capture-quality toggles: ?maxTickDist >= longest subject distance (default 120 m freezes telephoto subjects). ?objRadius=off for vistas (only if the memory budget allows). window.__occlusionCull.off=true during takes (prevents 1-2 frame NPC/interior pop-in on fast pans). Pose the film camera before tickPerFrame so culls are not one frame stale.

Before any drone or dolly path, pre-populate collision for every landblock the path crosses (populateBuildingAabbsForLandblock/populateStaticsAabbsForLandblock/populateSceneryCollidersForLandblock, or __diag.collision.populate). Wait one TickMovement and assert residency() counts are non-zero; otherwise the camera clips through walls outside the player's 3x3 ring.

Indoors, drive the viewer cell from the film camera: resolveViewerCell walked along the dolly path from a known cell, then setViewerCell. Pass explicit resident dungeon cell ids to the cell sweeps instead of getRenderSet(1), and use clipCameraToCellSpace along the path for containment.

For agent shot planning (outside the per-frame loop), build per-site obstacle maps from fetch_landblock_objects_soa, fetch_landblock_scenery_soa, the raw dist/scenery JSONL (aabb_min/max + obj_id), fetchEnvCellsInLandblock statics.aabbLocal, and vfxDescriptorFor archetypes (trunk-canopy/foliage-pollen = soft foliage, rigid-glint/tip-flex = props, buildings via isBuilding). JEV can score candidates offline from these.

Subject framing: use loadDatSelectionSphere(wasmExports.fetchSetupSelectionSphere, meta.setupId) and datSelectionSphereFor(rec, inst.root) for the framing sphere. Use objectPartDims for height (eye line ~0.9*height). Reuse the SelectionBracketLayer.tick projection (center +/- r along camera right/up) for screen-rect composition checks.

Respect the laptop rules when testing: these pieces can be unit-tested with targeted node tests (pure modules taking a mock session handle, as tests for projectile_sweep do). Leave the browser and 1070 validation to the orchestrator.
openQuestions: Will film mode drive the existing perspective camera (cameraSwitcher.persp, through a new film mode) or a separate THREE camera? Many consumers resolve cameraSwitcher.activeCamera ?? liveScene3d.camera: culls, viewer cell, tick gate, nameplate LOD, picking. Spawn-time LOD reads window.liveScene3d.camera.position directly.

Should film hide/fade be a first-class owner? That means a new _filmHidden composite term in entities.js and an honoured __filmHidden marker in statics.js cullStaticsGroup. The alternative is runtime monkeypatching. The first touches two hot files the orchestrator must merge carefully.

Which source decides obstruction: physics sweeps (cheap, complete only near the player, blind to canopies and awnings), visual raycasts (accurate, O(instances) per ray in three r184), or GPU occlusion queries (whole render, 1-2 frames late, outdoors only, no sample counts in WebGL2)? A hybrid needs a per-shot cost budget.

How should collision residency be handled for camera paths beyond the player's 3x3 ring: proactive populate*ForLandblock calls (async, applied next TickMovement, insert-only until landblock eviction), or constraining drone paths near the player? Is there a memory cost on the 8 GB laptop / 1070 for wide populates?

Particle obstruction: no helper exposes emitter world bounds. EntityManager._worldParticleManager.particleTable (Map id->emitter with parent, parentOffset, parts[]), _particleEmittersForGuid and scene3d._staticParticleManager exist, but bounds would need to come from live part meshes. Not verified beyond the constructor fields.

Is a 'query-only' mode wanted for OcclusionCuller, giving raw per-key results without hysteresis and without hiding rigs, so film can read GPU visibility while disabling occlusion-based hiding during takes?

Should the follow camera's player-anchored clip chain (_clipCameraAgainstWorld uses the player head as the sweep start) be generalised to an arbitrary pivot for film, or should film_los.js own its own chain?

area: PARTICLES/VFX, ATMOSPHERE, TIME OF DAY, WEATHER, POST-PROCESSING LOOK, CLOCKS (holtburger-web scene3d)
summary:
Paths below are relative to HB (apps/holtburger-web) unless they start with external/. Everything listed is reachable from page JS via CDP Runtime.evaluate, so none of it needs the Anthropic API.

1) PARTICLE RUNTIME AND ENUMERATION FOR OBSTRUCTION SCORING
- There are two ParticleManager instances.
  - World manager: `window.liveScene3d.entityManager._worldParticleManager`. Created at scene3d/entities.js:14588 with scene = entitiesGroup. It holds entity, PlayEffect and cast emitters.
  - Static manager: `scene3d._staticParticleManager`, created at scene3d/statics.js:4986 with scene = staticsGroup. It holds default_script fountains, braziers, torches, the foliage ambient emitters, the sky chain and the terrain families. It is stamped on the internal `scene3dForBuilders` facade, so it is often NOT present on `window.liveScene3d` (see the facade check at scene3d/index.js:4920-4924).
- `_allManagers` (scene3d/particles/particle_manager.js:1337) is module-private. The reliable discovery path is the owner facade `ownerRegistry` (scene3d/particles/owner_registry.js:549, default ON):
  - `_owners`: Map ownerKey → {ids: Map<emitterId, manager>, scoped, pending}.
  - `_byMgr` (line 185): WeakMap manager → Map<emitterId, ownerKey>, giving an O(1) reverse owner lookup.
  - Reach it with `await import('./scene3d/particles/owner_registry.js')`. index.html imports scene3d/index.js with a `?v=` query, but the submodules resolve to canonical URLs, so the import returns the same module instance.
- Owner keys:
  - an entity guid (a number); PlayEffects register under the TARGET's guid;
  - `static:<lbKey decimal>` for outdoor and cell default_script anchors (vfx/particle_attach.js staticOwnerKeyForLb);
  - `static:<seq>` as the fallback;
  - `sky:<pesId>` for the camera-following sky chain;
  - `static:<lbKey>:volcano|swamp|…` for the terrain families.
- Static anchors are THREE.Group objects under staticsGroup with `userData {isStaticScriptAnchor, defaultScriptId, landblockId, particleOwnerKey, [isCellStaticScriptAnchor, cellId]}` (scene3d/statics.js:5433, :5574).
- Per manager, `mgr.particleTable` is a Map<id, ParticleEmitter> (particle_manager.js:1420). Per emitter:
  - `parent`: the anchor Object3D (entity rig or static Group).
  - `partIndex`, and `parentOffset.position/quaternion` (the static offset).
  - `info`: a ParticleEmitterInfo with `id` (the 0x32 DID), `hwGfxObjId`, `emitterType`, `particleType`, `birthrate`, `maxParticles`, `initialParticles`, `totalParticles`, `totalSeconds`, `lifespan`, `lifespanRand`, `minOffset/maxOffset`, `a/b/c`, `minA/maxA`, `startScale/finalScale`, `startTrans/finalTrans`, `isParentLocal`, `billboard`, `fxProfile`, and `sortingSphere.radius = max(maxOffset, maxA*lifespan)` (particle_emitter_info.js:125-138). The sphere ignores the B and C acceleration terms, so it underestimates gravity arcs and fountains.
  - `numParticles`, `stopped`.
  - `parts[i]`: the live slot meshes. `mesh.position` and `mesh.scale` (setScalar, lerped startScale→finalScale) are in `_scene`-local space; `mesh.userData.__op` is the opacity (1−translucency).
  - `particles[i].lifetime/lifespan`.
  - `_baseIsAdditive`: true means additive glow, drawn UNFOGGED (particles/additive_fog.js); false means alpha smoke (`_instAlpha`, alphaTest 0.1, depthWrite on, sorted back to front).
  - `skyGlow`: true for kilometre-scale sky sheets; exclude these.
  - `_instKey` (the gfxobj bucket), `renderLayer` (0 = world, 1 = indoor), `_rp6Culled`, `degradeDistance`, `_forceDegrade`, `_bbMode`.
  - A persistent emitter is one with `info.totalParticles==0 && totalSeconds==0`.
  - A projectile anchor has `parent.userData.__ballistic`.
- Coordinates: `_scene` is entitiesGroup or staticsGroup under worldRoot (rotation.x = −π/2, scene3d/index.js:1552-1562), so `_scene`-local is the AC frame (Z up, metres).
  - The default path is the instanced path (`?particleInstancing` and `?particleInstancingAlpha` are both ON). There, slot meshes are DETACHED transform carriers (onMeshActive = _NOOP).
  - For a particle's world position, use `mgr._scene.localToWorld(v.copy(mesh.position))`. `mesh.getWorldPosition` returns AC-local coordinates, and `__diag.probeNearestParticle` (scene3d/index.js:4707) has exactly this bug.
  - The anchor's world position is `parent.getWorldPosition()`; the cull adds `parentOffset.position.length()` to the radius.
  - Particle size = `geometry.boundingSphere.radius × mesh.scale.x`. The geometry is shared per gfxobj (`emitter._instGeom`).
- Classification oracle: data/particle-fx-catalog.json maps every 0x32 DID to {family, behavior, note, params incl. nearFade, surface, gfx}.
  - 2051 emitters in 44 families (fire, flame_tongue, smoke_dark, smoke_add, smoke_light, gas_alpha, mist_*, star, glow_orb, …).
  - 11 behaviours: swarm, standing, burst, trail, flash, plume, stream, fountain, implode, puff, drift.
- Visual extent that is NOT in particleTable: fxKids GPU children (`mgr._kids`), PlayEffect placeholder bursts (the `_activeBursts` Map in play_effect_vfx.js:573 is private and short-lived), fxLights point lights, fxDistort screen warp, the fxGlow halo buffer, fxDecals, and ground fog cards.

2) SUPPRESSING PARTICLES (NEAR FADE AND PER-EMITTER HIDE)
- Near fade:
  - It exists only per profile row, on the instanced FX shader: `if (vFxD.y>0) fxA *= smoothstep(0.35*nearFade, nearFade, clipW)` (particles/particle_fx.js:1002).
  - Catalog nearFade values are small (2000 of 2051 are >0, max 3.0 m, typically ≈0.2 m).
  - There is no global floor or override. Soft particles apply only in the late particlesOverClouds pass.
- Per-emitter cull authority is RP6 inside `_tickLatched` (particle_manager.js:2156).
  - The cull is re-evaluated every 6 ticks (line 171) against the frustum and a 220 m cap (line 177, `slack = 220 + radius`).
  - A culled emitter:
    - skips `_appendInstances` (its instances vanish that tick);
    - has its per-mesh slots hidden on every tick;
    - is frozen if persistent (thawed on re-entry);
    - virtual-emits if finite, and a count-bounded one is force-stopped after 30 s culled.
  - Hide hack: set `e._forceDegrade = true; e.degradeDistance = 0`, plus `e._rp6Culled = true` so it takes effect immediately. `_rp6ShouldCull` (line 1239) ORs in the degrade term. Restore with the saved values (the defaults are `Infinity`/`undefined`).
  - Ballistic anchors return before that term, so they cannot be hidden this way.
- Render-only hide (the simulation keeps running) exists only as the cell gate: `?particleCellGate=on` or `__setParticleCellGate(true)`. It applies to static anchors with `userData.cellId`, through `mgr._cellLookup`.
- Kill controls:
  - `mgr.stopParticleEmitter(id)` (line 2730) stops gracefully.
  - `mgr.destroyParticleEmitter(id)` (line 2739) removes immediately.
  - `ownerRegistry.stopSome`, `destroySome` and `destroyAllForOwner` work per owner.
- Bucket-level hide: `mgr._instBuckets` (key `${gfx}|${layer}[|a][|sky]` → {im, n, alpha}). `im.visible = false` hides every emitter sharing that gfxobj, but the fxGlow twin still draws (vfx/fx_glow_effect.js:139 checks ancestors only).
- Global switches:
  - `__particlesOverClouds.set(false)`
  - `__particleFx(false)` (neutral rows)
  - `__additiveFogBlack('retail'|'fade'|'off')`
  - `__setParticleInstancing(on)`
  - `?particleBillboard=off`

3) TIME OF DAY AND WEATHER
- Sky clock (wasm):
  - `SessionHandle.getSkyState()` → src/lib.rs:23531 `evaluate_sky_now()` reads JS `Date.now()` (wasm-bindgen glue calls the global at call time).
  - The evaluator (external/holtburger/crates/holtburger-world/src/sky.rs) computes `world_time = (now − anchor) + zero_time_of_year`.
  - The anchor is the server PortalYearTicks from ConnectRequest and every TimeSync, forward-only, under `?skyServerClock` (default ON). `=off` uses the legacy 1999-11-02 wall anchor.
  - `day_length` = 7620 s (11.34× compression).
  - `timeOfDayNormalized` ∈ [0,1); ×24 gives the hour, and 0.5 is Midsong.
  - The DayGroup (weather/sky set) comes from an LCG on (day, year).
  - The authored sun never sets: dirPitch floors at 0.9° from 23:02 to 03:50h and peaks at 90° at 14:40h. `?nightRamp` remaps elevation to −14° for the sky only.
- Runtime overrides:
  - `__sessionHandle.setSkyTimeOverride(t)` (d.ts:6366). NaN clears it. It returns false until `populateSkyDescFromRegion` has run, and is lost when EnteredWorld replaces the evaluator.
  - `setGameDayOverride(day, year)` (d.ts:6276) forces the DayGroup; `(0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF)` clears it.
  - Read-backs: `getSkyPortalTicks`, `getSkyObjectStates` (weather objects have props & 0x04), `derethCalendarAt`.
- `?skytime` (index.html:6311-6345, driven in pumpNetFrame at :6487-6512):
  - `accel` gives a 5-minute day via a per-pump override.
  - A number (hour 0-24, or a 0-1 fraction) is a one-shot sticky pin (`window.__skyTimePin`).
  - With no `?skytime`, the Always-daylight driver (CharacterOption 0x05, always_daylight.js:82) pins 0.5 on every 250 ms poll and NaN-clears on the off edge. It will fight a runtime override.
- Time-lapse is possible by calling `setSkyTimeOverride` each frame, with these caveats:
  - The RP3 SKY group (terrain sun push, `skyLightingController._lastState` snapshot, fog colour and band, atmosphereLights, atmosphereSky, skyDome, weather) runs at 10 Hz on the wall clock (loop.js:2667, :2995). `?frameBudget=off` or `?deferHz=60` makes it run every frame.
  - The terrain Gouraud light re-lights only on the 15 s `retailLightTick` (retail_light_tick.js:154). `__setTerrainLightScale(cur)` calls `invalidate()`.
  - The IBL environment refreshes every 15 s (`?iblRefreshMs`, minimum 1000).
  - The colour-grade night blend is smoothed by exp(−4·dt).
  - The takram moon and stars follow `getSkyPortalTicks` (Date.now; `portal_ticks_at` IGNORES the time-of-day override, sky.rs:485).
  - The AC moons orbit on the rAF timestamp × `?moonSpeed`.
  - The AC sky-object UV scroll runs on session-relative Date.now.
  - The DayGroup does not advance when the overridden time wraps past midnight.
- Weather:
  - Retail weather means DayGroup SkyObjects with props 0x04, plus PES chains: the moon nebula 0x330007DB and the storm lightning box 0x33000453, realized by skyDome.updateSkyParticleChains (`?skyBirds`, default ON).
  - Streak billboards draw only with `?skyWeather=on`.
  - NO rain or snow precipitation particle system exists; the weather/manager.js named in comments is absent from the tree.
  - Runtime knobs:
    - `__setWeather({is_storm, temperature_C, dewpoint_C, …})`: sticky per-field overrides (weather_state.js:250) that drive the takram storm look (`?clouds=on` only) and the VFX weather uniforms;
    - `__clearWeatherOverride()`;
    - `__setWeatherProfile(idx, partial)` (the 20-entry table is INFERRED, not retail).
- Fog:
  - `scene.fog` is a linear THREE.Fog rewritten every sky tick by loop.js:2016 tickDistanceFogColor. The band comes from SkyState fogMin/fogMax, re-anchored to the drawn ring edge; the colour comes from the horizon sky radiance probe.
  - Only `?farFogNear` and `?farFogFar` pin it. These are read from `location.search` on every call (far_terrain_flags.js:317-329).
  - Client-side override: `window.__environFogOverride = environFogFor(1..6)` (environ_override.js:81; Red, Blue, White, Green, Black, Black2). It must be a fresh object; it fades in over about 20 s in 0.8 s ticks; null clears it.
  - The character options "Disable distance fog" and "Disable most weather effects" kill fog and weather respectively.

4) LOOK CONTROLS
The `__set*` helpers in scene3d/index.js are installed in the same synchronous callback that fires bootState 'ready' (index.js:6290 → 6323-6366). They are absent under `?wireframe=1`.

| Area | Controls |
|---|---|
| Exposure and light | `__setExposure(v)` (`?exposure`, default 5, range 0.1-20); `__setWorldLightScale(v)` (default 0.4); `__setTerrainLightScale(v)` (default 0.55); `__setAmbTintSat(v)` |
| Bloom and vignette | `__setBloomIntensity` / `__setBloomThreshold` (0.55 / 1.1); `__setVignetteDarkness` / `__setVignetteOffset` (0.3 / 0.5). These return null unless the preset built bloom (mid+) or vignette (high+). |
| Sun, moon, sky glow | `__setSunSize(rad)`, `__setMoonSize(rad)`; `__setMoon*` (ac_moons.js:1539-1615); `__skyGlow` |
| Colour grade | `__grade` {day, night, off, reset(), state()} (color_grade.js:194); GRADE_DAY and GRADE_NIGHT are blended by night fraction |
| Tone curve | `?tone=neutral|agx|aces` is URL-only. At runtime, `__atmospherePipeline.toneMapping.mode` (pmndrs) can be set, which recompiles. |
| AO and haze | `__ssao` {params, set(o), off, stats} (high/ultra or `?ssao=on`); `__layerHaze` {strength, params} (default 0.4) |
| FX effects | `__fxGlow` {intensity, strength, radius}; `__fxDistort` {amplitude}; `__fxDecals`; `__fxTier2` {stretchT (particle motion-streak shutter), minPx} |
| Clouds (`?clouds=on` only) | `__setCloudCoverage`, `__setCloudQuality`, `__setLightShafts`, `__setCloudShadowStrength`, `__setCloudShadowEnabled`, `__applyCloudWeather`, `__resetCloudLayers` |
| Shadows | CSM has no window setter. It uses `liveScene3d.csmState`, `invalidateCsm`, `DEFAULT_CSM_SPLITS` [30, 100, 300], fit to `cameraSwitcher.activeCamera` (lighting.js:1688) |
| Fog | `?radialFog=on` makes fog range-based, so it does not change with camera yaw (pans) |
| Render | `__setRenderScale(n)` |

5) POST-PROCESSING
- The composer is built in scene3d/atmosphere_pipeline.js `createAtmospherePipeline` (:829), with `new EffectComposer(renderer, {frameBufferType: HalfFloat, multisampling: msaa(2), stencilBuffer: flag})` at :939.
- Pass order:
  1. [sky RenderPass]
  2. CameraLayerMask
  3. world RenderPass (:1141)
  4. [portal punch / seal]
  5. depth ClearPass
  6. cellsMask, cells RenderPass (:1330), mask restore
  7. NanScrub EffectPass (:1634)
  8. [SsaoPass] (:1638)
  9. [LayeredHaze, if the chain is unsplit]
  10. fxPass (:1641)
  11. split chain only: ParticlesOverClouds, late scrub, LayeredHaze, fxPostPass (:1648)
- Legacy single fxPass (:1609/:1629), which is the default boot when clouds are off: [HeatHaze?, FxDistort?, SsaoComposite?, FxDecals?, Clouds?, AerialPerspective, HorizonDissolve(off), FxGlow?, LensFlare(off, `?lensFlare=on`), Bloom?, Vignette?, ToneMapping(Neutral), ColorGrade, Dithering].
- Split chain, only with `?clouds=on` + cloudsMainPass + particlesOverClouds (:1595-1602): atmosEffects into late target T, then postEffects [FxGlow, LensFlare, Bloom, Vignette, ToneMapping, ColorGrade, Dithering].
- Not present: depth of field / bokeh, motion blur, chromatic aberration, grain, SMAA/FXAA (MSAA only), LUT, and god rays (except takram lightShafts when clouds are on). The CDN postprocessing@6.39.1 (index.html:995; the same build is in node_modules) ships DepthOfFieldEffect (build/index.js:5430), BokehEffect, RealisticBokehEffect, ChromaticAberrationEffect, NoiseEffect, TiltShiftEffect, LUT3DEffect, GodRaysEffect and SMAAEffect.
- Adding DoF for rack focus:
  1. Build `new DepthOfFieldEffect(camera, {focusDistance, focusRange, bokehScale, resolutionScale})`.
  2. Put it before fxGlow/bloom: postEffects at :1596 (split), or after horizonDissolve in the legacy list at :1629.
  3. The effect's EffectAttribute.DEPTH makes the pass request depth. The CoC shader decodes logarithmic depth itself (`USE_LOGARITHMIC_DEPTH_BUFFER` block, build/index.js:4937). The renderer uses logarithmicDepthBuffer:true (index.js:1162). Never hand-decode log depth a second time; see the history at atmosphere_pipeline.js:288-306.
  4. Rack focus: animate `dof.cocMaterial.focusDistance`, or set `dof.target` to a THREE-world Vector3 for autofocus (calculateFocusDistance :5642 measures euclidean distance from the camera).
  5. Camera switch: `set mainCamera` (:5513) re-copies near/far, and `retargetFxPass` (:1773) fans out to `fxPass` and `fxPostPass.mainCamera`.
- pmndrs gotcha: the base Pass `mainCamera` setter is a no-op. LayeredHazePass, SsaoPass, ParticlesOverCloudsPass and PortalPunchPass keep their own `.camera`/`setCamera`. `pipeline.render(cam)`'s camera-switch branch (:2131-2141) does NOT retarget SSAO or LayeredHaze; only `pipeline.setCamera` (:2236) does, and nothing calls it.

6) CLOCKS
There is no shared clock and no global time scale. The sources are:

| Clock | What it drives |
|---|---|
| rAF timestamp → `tick(nowTs)` (index.js:2487). dt is clamped to 0.1 (:2512) with a recovery freeze; recovery is disabled under renderOnDemand. Published as `liveScene3d.frameTime` {tsMs, tsSec, dt} (:2532). | terrain water and lava uTime (loop.js:1146); the VFX master clock VFX_GLOBALS.uTime, which drives grass and tree wind sway, oscillators, weather inputs and flame flicker (loop.js:1190); ground fog; AC moons (ts); entity mixers, camera and ambient audio (dt); composer dt, which drives takram cloud advection plus TAA jitter and colour-grade smoothing |
| Particle simulation and PhysicsScript queues: `time_rng.currentTime()` (latched per manager tick) | Default `?particleClock=off` uses `performance.now()/1000`. `=sim` installs `liveScene3d._particleSimNowS += clamped dt`, bounded by wall time (index.js:5431, loop.js:3354). RNG comes from `rng()` = Math.random. Both are overridable through the `setCurrentTime` and `setRng` module exports. |
| `performance.now` (wall clock) | particle FX shader time (`particleFxFrame()` :525, called with no arguments); the static manager's PRIVATE rAF loop in `particleClock=off` (statics.js:5771); animated_scenery's private rAF; PlayEffect burst rAF and one-shot setTimeout reapers; fx_lights; the RP3 throttles; retail light (15 s) and fog (0.8 s) ticks; the IBL cadence; `?skytime=accel` |
| `Date.now` | wasm sky time of day and DayGroup; moon and star date; AC sky UV scroll |
| `document.timeline.currentTime` | shared alpha bucket frame id |
| wasm physics | its own self-measured dt |

- `__renderOnce()` (index.js:3007) ignores its arguments and passes `performance.now()`, so a fixed dt per captured frame needs either a small code change (accept an explicit ts) or a page-level `performance.now`/`Date.now`/rAF virtualization.

seams.what: Active-camera resolution. Every subsystem reads `liveScene3d.cameraSwitcher.activeCamera ?? camera` per frame: the particle RP6 cull, billboards and alpha sort (particle_manager.js:925); CSM (lighting.js:1688); the composer render (index.js:2722/2779); skyDome.tick (loop.js:3198); and AC moons.
seams.filmUse: Install the film camera as activeCamera, or drive the boot liveScene3d.camera object directly (the simplest option). Set its pose BEFORE tickPerFrame's camera, entity and particle phases so billboards and cull use this frame's pose. Keep it unparented, since the sky sync and billboards treat camera.position/quaternion as world values. If it is a new camera object, also call __atmospherePipeline.setCamera(cam).

seams.what: Emitter enumeration for obstruction: ownerRegistry._owners / _byMgr plus mgr.particleTable plus emitter.info and parts[].
seams.filmUse: Each frame (after the particle tick, before render), build a list of {worldCenter = parent.getWorldPosition() + parentOffset, radius = sortingSphere.radius, live particle world positions via mgr._scene.localToWorld(mesh.position), size = geom.boundingSphere.radius*mesh.scale.x, opacity = userData.__op, additive = _baseIsAdditive, family = catalog[info.id], ownerKey}. Score camera→subject segment intersections (smoke and gas families occlude; additive fire brightens) and particles within about 2 m of the eye (a cloud on the lens).

seams.what: Per-emitter hide via the cull path: emitter._forceDegrade, degradeDistance and _rp6Culled.
seams.filmUse: Hide an obstructing emitter for one shot by setting _forceDegrade=true, degradeDistance=0, _rp6Culled=true, then restoring the saved values afterwards. Better: add a render-only `filmHidden` check beside the cell-gate branch in _tickLatched (skip _appendInstances, run _setPartsVisible(false)) so the simulation keeps running.

seams.what: Global particle near fade. A shader term already exists per row at particle_fx.js:1002, fed from FX_UNIFORMS (line 405).
seams.filmUse: Add a uniform-only floor, e.g. uFxNearFadeMin, and compute nearFade = max(vFxD.y, uFxNearFadeMin). This kills screen-filling smoke quads during dolly-throughs without a program-key change (respects the VFX write invariant). Only the instanced path is covered, which is the default.

seams.what: RP6 220 m particle distance cap (`_RP6.maxDistance`, read live from a module-level object).
seams.filmUse: Export a setter and raise it to 600-1500 m during aerial establishing shots. Otherwise all fires, smoke and portal swirls beyond 220 m + radius from the camera are frozen and hidden.

seams.what: Time-of-day override API: SessionHandle.setSkyTimeOverride / setGameDayOverride.
seams.filmUse: Golden hour or night shots: call setSkyTimeOverride(h/24) EVERY frame (cheap, and survives evaluator replacement). Time-lapse: t = t0 + rate·filmTime, with ?frameBudget=off and __setTerrainLightScale(cur) each frame. Weather: pick the DayGroup with setGameDayOverride(day, year) after a sweep that reads getSkyState().dayGroupIndex and getSkyObjectStates() props&4.

seams.what: Client fog override via window.__environFogOverride (read each sky tick).
seams.filmUse: Dramatic fog on demand without server admin: window.__environFogOverride = environFogFor(3) (WhiteFog, 30 m band). It fades over about 20 s; ?environRetail=off snaps. Clear with null.

Set setCurrentTime(() => filmClockSec) and setRng(seeded) via dynamic import of ./scene3d/particles/time_rng.js. Route particleFxFrame, animated_scenery, fx_lights and the moon/star date to the film clock.

hazards.what: Instanced slot meshes (the default path) are detached carriers, so mesh.getWorldPosition() returns _scene-local AC coordinates, not THREE world. __diag.probeNearestParticle uses getWorldPosition and is wrong on the default path.
hazards.mitigation: Convert with mgr._scene.localToWorld(v.copy(mesh.position)), or mgr._scene.matrixWorld × mesh.matrix.

hazards.what: The static ParticleManager is stamped on scene3dForBuilders. window.liveScene3d._staticParticleManager can be undefined, or a second instance if a lazy LB bake ran against the window facade.
hazards.mitigation: Discover managers via ownerRegistry._owners (rec.ids values) plus entityManager._worldParticleManager, or export an allParticleManagers() accessor from particle_manager.js.

hazards.what: The default ?particleClock=off ticks static emitters on a PRIVATE rAF loop. That loop is registered before the main tick, so it likely runs before the main tick's camera update: static billboards, alpha sort and cull use the previous frame's camera, and static particles keep simulating between __renderOnce calls. (Ordering inferred from rAF semantics; not measured.)
hazards.mitigation: Boot film sessions with ?particleClock=sim (or loop) so both managers tick in tickPerFrame after cameraSwitcher.tick.

hazards.what: The RP6 cull hides and freezes every emitter beyond 220 m + radius from the CAMERA, and rechecks only every 6 ticks. Aerial and drone wide shots lose all distant fire, smoke and portal effects, and fast pans can pop emitters in for up to 6 frames.
hazards.mitigation: Raise _RP6.maxDistance and set recheckInterval to 1 during film (needs a small exported setter).

hazards.what: Forcing the cull to hide an emitter has side effects. Persistent emitters freeze (ages thaw on re-entry). Finite emitters virtual-emit and are force-stopped after 30 s culled, so they may never return. Ballistic projectile emitters are exempt and cannot be hidden this way.
hazards.mitigation: Prefer a new render-only filmHidden flag mirroring the cell-gate branch. Keep hides under 30 s, or restore before they expire.

hazards.what: setTranslucency rewrites mesh.visible on every particle update, so a per-mesh hide written from outside is undone on the next tick.
hazards.mitigation: Hide through the manager (cull or flag path), or re-assert after the particle tick and before render.

hazards.what: Hiding an instanced bucket via im.visible=false still leaves its fxGlow halo. The glow twin checks ancestors only, not the bucket itself.
hazards.mitigation: Use emitter-level hiding, or also set __fxGlow.strength=0 during the shot.

hazards.what: Retail mode-2 billboards skip the update when the viewer line is parallel to world up, and spin rapidly near nadir. Synthesized sprites use setFromUnitVectors, whose roll is unstable near the anti-normal. Straight-down drone tilts over waterfalls, fires or portals show spinning or frozen quads.
hazards.mitigation: Keep top-down shots a few degrees off nadir, or add a film-mode stable-up override (e.g. use the camera's up vector) for billboards.

hazards.what: pipeline.render(cam)'s camera-switch branch does not retarget SsaoPass or LayeredHazePass, and pipeline.setCamera() is never called. A separate film camera object gets AO and haze computed from the boot camera's pose and projection. Base pmndrs Pass.mainCamera is a no-op.
hazards.mitigation: Call __atmospherePipeline.setCamera(filmCam) once on switch, or drive the boot camera object itself.

hazards.what: Many independent clocks. Wall performance.now: particle sim default, particle FX shader time, fx_lights, animated_scenery private rAF, PlayEffect burst rAF and setTimeout reapers, RP3 10 Hz sky throttle, 15 s retail light tick, 0.8 s fog tick, IBL 15 s. Date.now: wasm sky time and DayGroup, moon and stars, AC sky UV scroll. rAF timestamp: water, VFX uTime (grass and tree sway), AC moons, mixers. Composer dt: cloud advection, TAA, grade smoothing. __renderOnce always passes performance.now().
hazards.mitigation: For deterministic capture, either virtualize performance.now, Date.now and rAF at page level (Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument or CDP virtual time), or add explicit film-clock plumbing (tsMs into __renderOnce, plus setCurrentTime, particleFxFrame(nowMs), and the moon-date override).

hazards.what: In ?particleClock=sim the simulation clock is min(prev+dt, wallNow), so a virtual clock running ahead of wall time is clamped. The manager-phase double-call guard keys on performance.now(), so a frozen virtual performance.now would skip particle ticks.
hazards.mitigation: Under film mode, bypass the wall clamp and key the guard on a frame counter, or install setCurrentTime(filmClock) after boot (it overrides the sim install).

hazards.what: Time-lapse inconsistencies under setSkyTimeOverride: moon and stars ignore the override (portal ticks come from Date.now); the DayGroup does not change across the overridden midnight; terrain re-lights only every 15 s; the sky stack updates at 10 Hz; IBL every 15 s; colour-grade night blend lags (exp −4·dt).
hazards.mitigation: Use ?frameBudget=off (or ?deferHz=60), ?iblRefreshMs=1000, __setTerrainLightScale(cur) per frame, advance setGameDayOverride manually across midnight, and add a moon/star date override in sky_game_date.js for film.

hazards.what: The Always-daylight character option re-pins time of day to 0.5 every 250 ms (and NaN-clears on the off edge), fighting film overrides. The ?skytime pin is one-shot and is lost when populateSkyDescFromRegion replaces the evaluator. setSkyTimeOverride returns false before the SkyDesc lands.
hazards.mitigation: Boot with ?skytime=<h> (disables the daylight driver) or ensure option 0x05 is off. Re-assert the override every frame and check the boolean return.

hazards.what: The look setters (__setExposure, bloom, vignette, sun and moon size) only exist after the atmosphere composer reports 'ready'. They are absent with ?wireframe=1. Bloom is null at quality=low, vignette below high, SSAO below high. 'ready' and 'in-world' can arrive in either order on the one scalar.
hazards.mitigation: Film sessions use ?quality=ultra (or ?bloom=on&vignette=on&ssao=on). Wait on window.__sceneReadyEverFired===true plus __bootStateHistory containing 'in-world', and null-check every setter's return.

hazards.what: The renderer uses logarithmicDepthBuffer. pmndrs readDepth already decodes it for Effects with EffectAttribute.DEPTH; hand-decoding again previously replaced the whole town with sky. CoC near/far are copied by value.
hazards.mitigation: For DoF, use the stock DepthOfFieldEffect (CoC handles log depth) and getViewZ in custom effects. Re-set fxPostPass.mainCamera after changing camera.near or far.

hazards.what: Adding, removing or reordering effects in an EffectPass, or changing the tone-mapping mode, recompiles the merged program (about 3 s per program on the 1070). Changing light counts or per-instance program keys violates the VFX write invariant.
hazards.mitigation: Build the DoF (and any lens effects) once at pipeline construction behind a film flag. Animate only uniforms (focusDistance, bokehScale, blendMode.opacity) per shot.

hazards.what: scene.fog near, far and colour are overwritten every sky tick. The horizon fog band is anchored to the drawn streaming-ring edge, so drone shots far from the player can expose fog walls or unloaded edges. Planar fog makes distant objects gain and lose fog during pans unless ?radialFog=on.
hazards.mitigation: Use ?radialFog=on for film. Pin via ?farFogNear/?farFogFar (read live from location.search) or add a film fog override. Coordinate with the streaming subsystem for camera-centred residency.

hazards.what: No rain or snow precipitation system exists (the weather/manager.js referenced in comments is absent). Weather visuals are limited to DayGroup sky objects, ?skyWeather streak billboards, the storm lightning sky chain, takram storm clouds (?clouds=on) and fog.
hazards.mitigation: Treat 'rain' shots as fog, storm clouds or lightning, or add a film-side precipitation emitter via ParticleManager.addEmitter.

hazards.what: Additive particles are drawn unfogged, matching retail, so fires and portals glow at full strength through heavy fog. Alpha smoke is fogged.
hazards.mitigation: Account for this in fog-heavy compositions, or use __additiveFogBlack('fade') per shot.

hazards.what: The particlesOverClouds split chain (particles drawn after clouds and aerial perspective) exists only with ?clouds=on. On split frames (indoor depth split, punch) particles stay in the world or cells pass, and soft particles are off.
hazards.mitigation: Know which chain is live (__particlesOverClouds.stats().why) before inserting DoF. Test DoF on both the legacy and split chains.

recommendations: Film boot URL baseline: ?quality=ultra&frameBudget=off&particleClock=sim&radialFog=on&iblRefreshMs=1000&nosw=1, plus ?renderOnDemand=1 for frame-stepped capture. Add ?clouds=on only on the 1070, since SwiftShader zero-bakes the cloud 3D textures.

Drive the existing boot camera (liveScene3d.camera), or call __atmospherePipeline.setCamera(filmCam) on switch. Set the pose before tickPerFrame's particle and entity phases, keep the camera unparented, and build orientation from quaternions (slerp or parallel-transport). Never use lookAt at ±90° pitch.

Add film-only exports in particle_manager.js: allParticleManagers(), setParticleCullConfig({maxDistance, recheckInterval}), and an emitter.filmHidden render-only flag handled next to the cell-gate branch (skip _appendInstances / _setPartsVisible(false)).

Add a global FX_UNIFORMS.uFxNearFadeMin (uniform-only) and use max(rowNearFade, uFxNearFadeMin) at particle_fx.js:1002 to prevent particle clouds on the lens. Scale the floor by camera speed and particle size.

Build the obstruction scorer from ownerRegistry + particleTable: sphere = anchor world position + |parentOffset|, radius = max(sortingSphere.radius, live particle extent), weight by catalog family (smoke_dark, gas_alpha, mist_white occlude; additive fire, star, glow only distract), numParticles and mean userData.__op. Exclude skyGlow emitters. Also test the near-eye volume (particles within about 2 m of the camera).

Construct DepthOfFieldEffect at pipeline build time behind a ?filmDof flag: in postEffects before fxGlow/bloom (split chain), and after horizonDissolve in the legacy list. Expose window.__dof {target, focusDistance, focusRange, bokehScale}. Rack focus = animate focusDistance, or set target to the subject's THREE-world position.

Add a film clock: __renderOnce(tsMs) passing an explicit ts; setCurrentTime and setRng (seeded) from time_rng.js; particleFxFrame(filmMs); animated_scenery and fx_lights reading the same clock; a sky_game_date override so moon and stars follow setSkyTimeOverride. Motion blur can then be done by accumulating N sub-frames in the capture tool (pmndrs has no motion blur effect).

For time of day and time-lapse, call setSkyTimeOverride every frame plus __setTerrainLightScale(__terrainLightState().scale) to force a terrain re-light. Advance setGameDayOverride across midnight. Pre-sweep (day, year) → dayGroupIndex and weather SkyObjects (props&0x04) once per session to get a weather menu for the planner.

Use the documented look handles (__setExposure, __grade.day/.night, bloom, vignette, __ssao, __layerHaze, __fxGlow) for per-shot grading. Snapshot their current values before a shot and restore them after.

Use window.__environFogOverride = environFogFor(n) for client-only fog moods instead of the server @setlbenviron command, which affects every player in the landblock. Budget the ~20 s fade-in, or use ?environRetail=off for a snap.

Is the static ParticleManager present on window.liveScene3d in the current 1070 build? Run `await __diag.portalEmitterState()` and check its .facade field.

Should DoF run before or after the late particle draw (blurred particles vs sharp ones)? How does it interact with 2× MSAA and the alpha-particle depth writes into composer.depthTexture inside the late pass?
What is an acceptable RP6 cull distance and recheck interval for film on the GTX 1070 (perf budget for hundreds of town emitters at 1 km)?
Which (day, year) pairs yield storm or foggy DayGroups in retail Dereth, and do the server's DayGroup and the client override stay consistent for other observers? (The override is client-only.)

Should film mode own a separate camera object (cleaner, but needs pipeline.setCamera plus CSM, IBL and cloud retargeting) or hijack the boot camera? This decision belongs to the camera-subsystem recon.

Exact rAF callback ordering between statics.js _spLoop and the main tick on headless Chrome under renderOnDemand. This determines whether static billboards lag the camera by a frame even with particleClock=off.
